about: Where series sit in each taxonomy (server/seed/data/taxonomies/; GLOSSARY.md). Per taxonomy: `measures` places each measure (MEASURES in server/lib/series-dimensions.js), and its series follow it; `series` places a series apart from its measure, only where it differs. A placement is { category, basis, tables | reason }: basis 'table' when an Abstract table prints the series' own data, from the same publisher (its table numbers; the table must be printed in that category); 'judgement' when GovGraph chose (a sentence saying why, naming the nearest table where there is one). { left_out: true, reason } keeps one out of a taxonomy on purpose. The Abstract's were set from its tables in Phase 4 (2026-10-13). Checked by server/lib/taxonomies.test.js; stored by server/seed/load-taxonomies.js; see features/taxonomies.

crude-oil-price.reason: No table prints the WTI or Brent spot price. Table 730 prints EIA's composite crude oil price (refiners' acquisition cost) with the other fuel prices, so crude oil prices sit there.

fuel-price.reason: EIA's retail gasoline and diesel prices: Table 730 (national, by fuel) and Table 731 (selected cities).

oil-demand.reason: Table 938 prints EIA's domestic demand for refined oil products (product supplied), from the Monthly Energy Review.

unemployment.reason: BLS Current Population Survey: unemployed workers by age, sex and race (622), by industry and sex (625), by education, sex, race and Hispanic origin (627).

consumer-prices.reason: Table 725: the CPI-U, all items and all items less food and energy. The PCE price indexes are placed apart (Table 739).

consumer-spending.reason: BEA's personal consumption expenditures, current and chained dollars: within GDP (667) and by function (677).

consumer-sentiment.reason: No table prints the University of Michigan's index. Table 787 prints the Conference Board's economic indexes, the Abstract's other survey-based indicators.

mortgage-rate.reason: Table 1197 prints a 30-year fixed mortgage rate with the market interest rates, but from Bankrate (copyright), not Freddie Mac's survey.

home-prices.reason: Census new-home prices: price indexes (973) and median sales price (975). FHFA's house price index is placed apart (Table 729).

home-affordability.reason: No table prints a home affordability index; the Atlanta Fed's measure started after 2011. Placed with the costs of owning a home (Tables 992–1004).

homeownership.reason: Census Housing Vacancies and Homeownership: rates by age and household type (992) and by state (993).

household-income.reason: Census median household income in current and constant dollars, from the CPS (Table 691).

interest-rate.reason: The Fed's H.15: federal funds, prime and Treasury bill rates (1197) and Treasury bond yields (1198).

deaths.reason: Our series are NCHS's COVID-19 counts, which began in 2020. Table 109 prints NCHS's deaths and death rates by sex, race and Hispanic origin; placed with them.

gdp.reason: BEA's GDP in current and chained (2005) dollars (Table 667).

federal-debt.reason: Table 470 prints gross federal debt and debt held by the public by fiscal year from OMB, not Treasury's Debt to the Penny; placed with it.

federal-revenue.reason: OMB's receipts, total (469) and by source (475). The Treasury and BEA revenue series sit with them.

tax-credit-payments.reason: Paid out through the Treasury in 2020–2021; no table holds them. Table 492 prints the tax credits claimed on returns; placed with it.

federal-spending.reason: OMB's outlays: total (469), by type (471), by function (473). The Treasury and BEA spending series sit with them.

federal-budget-balance.reason: OMB's surplus or deficit, beside receipts and outlays (Table 469).

tax-rate.reason: No table prints CBO's average tax rates or the IRS rate schedule. Table 494 prints effective and marginal income tax rates (Treasury); placed with it.

tax-share.reason: No table prints CBO's shares of federal taxes; placed with the income tax tables, beside the rates (Table 494).

top-bracket-threshold.reason: Part of the income tax rate schedule, which no table prints; placed with the income tax tables (Table 494).

tariff-rate.reason: No table prints customs duties (Table 475 counts them within Other receipts). Placed with the imports they are charged on (Tables 1307–1312).

exports.reason: Census exports by country (1307). BEA's exports, printed within GDP (667) and the international transactions (1286), sit with them.

imports.reason: Census imports by country (1307). BEA's and USITC's imports sit with them.

trade-balance.reason: Census merchandise trade balance by country (1307). BEA's trade balance sits with it.

pce-price.reason: The Abstract prints BEA's PCE price indexes apart from the CPI, with the other chain-type price indexes (Table 739).

house-prices.reason: The Abstract prints FHFA's house price index with the price indexes, by state (Table 729), not with home sales.

fuel-price.reason: Natural Gas & Oil: gasoline and diesel are oil products.

consumer-prices.reason: CAP's Interest Rates subtopic covers inflation, cost of living and prices.

mortgage-rate.reason: Interest Rates; Housing (14) is the alternative.

home-prices.reason: Housing, General: no subtopic for the housing market.

household-income.reason: No subtopic for household income; Macroeconomics, General. A weak fit.

interest-rate.reason: Monetary Policy: the Fed's rate and target range; Interest Rates (101) is the alternative.

deaths.reason: Health, General; Disease Prevention (331) for COVID-19 deaths is the alternative.

federal-revenue.reason: National Budget; Tax Code (107) is the alternative.

tax-share.reason: Tax Code: the impact of taxes.
